name: LEFT_ARROW_YELLOW_SQUARE

t5-6_arrow_left.desc: large arrow pointing left, 454 long x 400 high: head 262 long, shaft 192 long x 125 wide, R18 tips, 92 and 35 barb dims

notes: Arrow 73 from each side, 100 top/bottom: 454 x 400. Points left as drawn. Inset: head 262, shaft 192 (125 at the tail, 92 at the head junction), notch 35, R18 tip and barbs. Arrow drawn as an exact polygon from the inset dimensions (tip and barb radii inscribed so the outline reaches the stated extremes; shaft tapers from the head junction to the tail as dimensioned).
